title.narrative: Promoting inclusive TVET and decent employment for persons with disabilities

description.narrative: This programme addresses the knowledge and capacity gaps of education and employment providers to implement two urgent prerequisites of the CRPD: equality and non-discrimination, and provision of inclusive services, which consequently limits persons with disabilities to exercise their rights to inclusive education and job opportunities, as well as to actively participate in society (SDG 10). This programme seeks to reinforce disability inclusion within public institutions by enhancing the capacity of key actors, as well as strengthen institutional partnerships (SDG 17) to provide technical-productive education and employment services from an inclusive perspective. Therefore, it will develop practical tools and strategies to contribute to disability-inclusive policies and services, ensuring a gender approach (SDG 5), to create preconditions for the application of the CRPD.
